purpose: Small synthetic development pilot for ontology and annotation diagnosis; never fresh acceptance evidence.
authorship_scope: Queries, labels, spans and rationales synthesized in this author context from the task contract and permitted capability evidence. No external model calls.
decision_class_source: Parent task supplied the six existing class names; exact decision semantics were not present in ontology.py, so borderline notice/relation decisions remain development hypotheses for independent review.

allowed_evidence.read_scope: Definition-name search for matches/sort and displayed lines 295 through 344: matches and sort_books, with incidental intervening primary_match helper exposure.

incidental_scope_deviation: The contiguous display range between matches and sort_books exposed primary_match, a small intervening helper. This was reported to the parent promptly. Therefore strict matches/sort-only isolation is not claimed.

failed_path_probe.result: Path absent; no content read. Parent then supplied search/query_plan.py.

whole_file_hash_note: SHA256 hashes identify the full source files; hashing did not expose other source text to the author.
independence_limitations: This is model-authored synthetic development material, not human annotation.
A separate author context does not establish a different actual model or statistical independence.
No independent review has yet been performed by this author; review claims require the separately recorded reviewer result.
The pilot was created with the ontology/capability contract visible and must never be treated as a fresh heldout acceptance set.
Native capability evidence comes only from the displayed production predicates and sort routine, not an end-to-end execution test.
The incidental helper exposure limits the intended source isolation.

annotation_conventions.spans: Python Unicode character offsets [start,end) into immutable original query; each stored text verified in memory.
annotation_conventions.expected_native_fields: Only definite applicable mandatory fields are projected; unsupported, missing, alternative, advisory, background and contradictory operations do not silently become hard fields.
annotation_conventions.unsupported_sort_operand: RATING_ASC preserves a requested unsupported ascending direction; it is not claimed to be a supported enum.
annotation_conventions.native_title_caveat: Displayed matches allows title_text containment in title or author; the title-containment row explicitly records this observed limitation.

validation.method: In-memory structural assertions only; no parser or model execution.
checks: all queries at most 500 Unicode characters
